item.title: [cybercrime] Russian authorities arrest alleged LeakBase admin behind stolen data marketplace
item.description: Russian authorities arrested the alleged LeakBase admin for running a marketplace selling stolen data since 2021. Russian law enforcement has arrested the suspected administrator of LeakBase, a cybercrime forum used to trade stolen personal data.
